description: The Emerging Leaders Series prepares second-year undergraduate and master's students for future internship opportunities at Goldman Sachs. Through business-specific training, interview preparation, networking, and engagement with senior leaders, participants develop the skills and insights to…

Explore the inner workings of our business in this daylong program for first- and second-year university students. You'll spend the day focusing on one of two tracks — Strategy and Product or Institutional Sales and Trading — depending on where you join us.
Break Through Tech is expanding access to career pathways for undergraduate students pursuing tech careers.

Whether you’re an undergraduate, MBA candidate or advanced degree student, our summer and winter internships are designed to help kick-start your career. From exceptional experiences and new relationships to learning and development opportunities, we are committed to helping you succeed.
